review_description: After obtaining three initial quotes through this website, I decided to work with evergreen electrical to arrive at a suitable configuration for our site at Newmarket in Brisbane.  Jake was very helpful and after a number of iterations we settled on 8kW of Tiger Neo Panels, an 8kW SunGrow Inverter and a 12.8kWh SunGrow battery.Overall, I was extremely pleased with the process.  The evergreen team arrived when the said they would, completed a thoroughly professional installation, including removal and replacement of the old inefficient solar panels, cleaned up after themselves, and completed commissioning and testing all on the same day.System performance has been great and the iSolarCloud app which has been provided reports that I have purchased only 13 kWh of power since the plant was installed over two months ago. Previously, we would use this amount in a single day.

Given the size of this install with 31 PV panels, a 48kWh battery, 3-phase inverter and full house backup gateway, I wanted to choose the right installer. Three quotes in, it was clear to me that Evergreen was my pick.From the beginning, they were highly responsive, professional, and knowledgeable. They answered all my questions and guided me into the right solution for my objectives.The install was handled extremely professionally and efficiently with a great team, who left the place spotless.Really happy with the result. No issues with the install and really happy with the outcome.

Jake and the team at Evergreen were exactly the installer I'd hoped to find when we started looking for quotes. Fast to respond, happy to answer all our questions, and were more than happy to tailor their quotes to our specific wants.They also didn't miss a beat when we decided to change our mind from a Sungrow system to a Sigenery system after we'd already pulled the trigger and were waiting for the install day. The only hiccup along the way was delays in Sigenergy stock deliveries, which was obviously out of their control, so no complaints there.On the day, the crew arrived bright and early, walked us through the plan, and helped us finalise the location for the battery. And even though replacing our existing SolarEdge inverter required all of the panels to be taken down to remove the optimisers, they still managed to complete the whole job that day. No fuss, no mess.The system has been humming along perfectly since then. I expect their after-sales support is also great, but the install and system seem to be good enough that we may never find out!

The quote process was excellent. Jake was available at all hours and responded immediately. He walked us through configuration of a 2 phase system and provided product options that were best suited to our needs. Great technical knowledge.The installation team lead by Tom exceeded our expectations. From on time arrival, polite technicians, knowledgeable crew, care for customers property and commitment to ensure all facets met and exceeded our needs.A GREAT experience overall. Thanks Evergreen Electrical Services

The quotation process was informative and responded to my needs and questions which resulted in a better system scope and specifications compared to my original thinking of my requirements.The installation team were on time, efficient and respectful throughout including ensuring everything was spotless after completing the job.The grid connection and monitoring app set up was straightforward and prompt. And I was impressed with the quick support from Evergreen team to reset my monitor connection when the inverter was isolated and then reset ahead /after the cyclone Alfred.. I remain very happy with the solar installation.

Evergreen were quick to give me a quote, responded to all my questions and did a great job with the install of solar and battery on my house in Brisbane.It looks great and performs exactly as it is supposed to. They were even helpful when I wanted to know what to do in the face of an impending cyclone earlier in the year, despite I'm sure having lots of questions coming in and lots to do.

From start to the finish Evergreen Electrical Services ticked all the boxes. I had a response to my request for a quote in< 1 hour. Followed by a meeting to discuss our requirements and provide a quote within days and the solar system installation within the agreed timeframe and at a great price too.I couldn’t be happier with Evergreen Electrical Services, they listened to what we wanted then explained all our options, advised and guided us in our choices to ensure that system would meet our needs. The installation team were fantastic,  and so too the customer service, they organised all the grid connections we didn’t have to do a thing.

The initial quoting process was great. Evergreen were completely open to offering any combination of brands I wanted. After doing thorough research and gauging offerings from other quotes, I pestered them for quotes on a tonne of different configurations. They were more than happy to oblige and I appreciate that. They were up front about the discounted pricing they could get on the panel brand I was looking for too, which is the type of transparency I look for. Out of all the quotes I received for the same configuration, Evergreen's was the best value for money.On installation day, the Evergreen team liaised with me to confirm where I wanted the inverter. They did a quick assessment on roof layout. I have various skylights and vents scattered across the roof, but they did a good job fitting the whole system up there working around these obstacles. I'm extremely pleased with the way it turned out.The team walked me through the setup, and confirmed I had access to the cloud app. They also notified me of all the paperwork that needed to be signed and would be submitted by them.

Low pressure sales approach, happy to provide alternate optionsInstallation was a challenge due to weather but the installer persevered to complete the install in as short a timeframe as possibleGreat service, answered all questions quickly and provided demos of the monitoring apps

During the quoting process followed by the installation they were very helpful and allowed us to make decisions best suited to our needs at the time. When we mentioned the need to have the meter box to be moved about 60 cms this was included and completed at no extra cost. The sales and installation team were professional and helpful right through the process. Will use them for any additional follow up installations when required.

The sales process was simple and quote was supplied same day. All paperwork was completed by Evergreen. Installers were great, polite and tidied up. Set up the app for monitoring solar production and ran through shut down process.

Friendly and helpful team, both on the sales and installation side. Shopped around and the Evergreen quote represented great value. Short lead times. Great post-sales communications. Very happy with the whole experience.

We are so pleased with the service we received from Evergreen electrical (Mansfield, Brisbane.)From the quoting process right through the installation they were polite , professional , informative and no pushy salesman!Had the system set up almost 2 months and can see a difference in our upcoming bill. Very happy customers.
The guys were on time, professional and fantastic. Took the time to run everything through with me at the end as well!

Competive pricing.Prompt, reliable service.Neat tradesman like installation.Good communication.No problems accessing staff to resolve any technical issues after installation, by phone or a site visit.
Pleasure to deal with. Communication was great and the installation was very smooth. Would recommend.

The sales people were friendly and knowledgeable. Installation was seamless with a very friendly, easy to communicate with team. They explained the setup well and tidied up after their work. All the paper work for the connection was done by them and the reconfigure of the meter is to be done soon. I would highly recommend them. The system is working well after 10 days.
I highly recommend this company because they provided: reliable prices, good communication, professional installation and most importantly good quality products.

There is a lot to know, you need to have confidence that you are in the hands of someone who knows what they are doing, Evergreen was without fault or hesitation the best for us.  The also have their own team do the installation and electrical work, which was the deciding factor for us.  Nothing was a problem, even relocation and upgrade of the meter box. Polite, Tidy, very Punctual.

I had Evergreen Electrical install a 10.12kW array (across two strings on four roof aspects), 10 kW 3-phase hybrid inverter and a 25.2 kWh battery. All panels on one of the strings had Tigo optimisers to deal with some afternoon shading.This was my dream system and Evergreen provided by far the most ecomoncal & competitive quote (out of several quotes I obtained), but not at any expense to their professional and prompt service, quality of product and quality of install. The sales team answered my many RFIs promptly and worked with me patiently to get the best arrangement and layout. The installation team were professional, explaining everything to me along the way and did a great job on the install.The system is working brilliantly and with the strong on my eastern aspect, it is producing from 7am. I switched over to a VPP and the system is now making me money.I am very happy with Evergreen, very highly recommended.

This, by far the best, and most professional service I have ever received from a company.I have ordered and installed a BYD Solar Battery system that was integrated with my exiting solar system.The entire process from quote to delivery and commissioning been spot on. If anyone is on the market for a top notch company ... this is the one!You get to deal with really polite and very friendly people, from customer service to the electricians and installers, no exception!Quick, easy and best price. You cannot go wrong!I do have to mention Jake, that has been an excellent professional. He went the extra mile, and never give up on getting to the bottom of the issues discovered and get it fixed. Turned out some installation mistakes done by the the Solar panel company. Great work, mate!I will always recommend this company.

Nice people to work with. They were able to give me the exact system I wanted in terms of battery and additional panels to match my current solaredge system. The price was better than that quoted by my original installer and involved the same size, replacement inverter to what I currently had. The new inverter was a little tricky for them to setup - not sure how many people get solaredge batteries. The battery is working really well.
From end to end Evergreen we’re just awesome. Sales, and installation communications  excellent.

A special thank you to Jake, Storm, Cayenne and the team at Evergreen Electrical for the wonderful work they did on our solar system. The team installed a 20Kw system and blended the whole system beautifully with the roof while the output so far have far exceeded expectations. Jake really went the extra mile and it shows.
Good design, quality equipment, knowledgeable local installer, helpful but not pushy.

Evergreen were able to listen to my preferences, provide sound advice and adjust quotes all in a timely manner.  They installed when they said they would and a month after installation are happy to take a call and answer questions.The installation appears professional and changes need on the day due to internals of the roof were explained well and confirmed before proceeding.
Matt was brilliantSupervisor on the day was brilliantSo far customer service great
